dedupe_keys.name: gas supply and demand forecasts and historical data plan4res from entsog

description: This data set repackages European gas supply and demand forecasts and historical flows from the European network of gas transmission operators (ENTSOG) into the plan4res model format. It was prepared by Inci Yueksel-Erguen for the European plan4res project and is documented in plan4res deliverable D4.5. Contents are yearly gas supply and demand forecasts for 2020 to 2040 by country and balancing zone from the ENTSOG TYNDP 2018 final scenario reports; historical physical flows for 2015 to 2019 from the ENTSOG Transparency Platform, giving the yearly split of EU supply sources such as Russia, Norway and indigenous production and the demand of countries and balancing zones; gas time-series profiles; and lists describing the geography and the historical series. Coverage is European countries and balancing zones. Files are small CSV tables, downloadable from Zenodo (version 1.1.0, April 2021) under CC BY 4.0 at no cost. Caveats: forecasts date from the 2018 TYNDP, before the 2022 supply shock, and the format is specific to plan4res. Simulation uses are European gas network and security of supply studies, including supply disruption scenarios. Related records: model-open-tyndp works with later TYNDP data.
